label: NWS River Forecasts (NWPS) → TAK
info:
NWS forecast river gauges, colored by the worst observed or forecast flood level (purple major, red moderate, orange minor, yellow action, green none). The forecast crest is in the marker remarks.

Data: NWS National Water Prediction Service (https://water.noaa.gov/). Updates every 15 minutes.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/nws-river-forecasts
